postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y unzip && curl -sSL $(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Azure/aztfexport/releases/latest | grep browser_download_url | grep linux_amd64.zip | cut -d '"' -f4) -o /tmp/aztfexport.zip && sudo unzip -o /tmp/aztfexport.zip -d /usr/local/bin aztfexport && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/aztfexport && rm /tmp/aztfexport.zip
